name: Growthpoint Properties Limited
summary: Growthpoint Properties Limited is an international property company that provides space to thrive incorporating innovative and sustainable property solutions. Growthpoint is the largest South African (SA) primary JSE-listed REIT with a quality portfolio of 492 properties across three major business units: Directly held  SA portfolio, Offshore investments, Third-party fund management business  Growthpoint Investment Partners (GIP). Growthpoint Properties Limited was incorporated on 12th October 1987 in South Africa.
